findings.evidence: 1/1 dated-content pages affected (100.0%). No datePublished or dateModified in markup.
findings.mechanism: Recency is one of the few quality signals available without reading the content. An undated page cannot be preferred over an older competitor, and cannot be ruled out as stale either, so it tends to be passed over when a current answer is wanted.

steps: Add datePublished and dateModified in ISO-8601 to the Article node.
Show the date visibly near the headline.
Update dateModified only on genuine content changes.
suggested_action.summary: Emit datePublished and dateModified in JSON-LD and show a visible date.
suggested_action.verification: Dates present on most content pages.

findings.evidence: 1/3 HTML pages affected (33.3%). Most recent copyright year seen: 2019 (current year 2026).
findings.mechanism: A visibly outdated copyright line is a cheap, prominent signal that the site is unmaintained, and it appears on every page. It invites a consumer to discount otherwise current content.

steps: Generate the year at build or request time.

findings.mechanism: Attribution is a provenance signal: content traceable to a named, credentialed person is weighted more heavily than anonymous copy, particularly on subjects where expertise matters.

steps: Add a Person author node to Article markup.
Publish author pages stating relevant credentials.
Link the author page from every byline.
suggested_action.summary: Attribute every article to a named author with an author page.
